title: David S. Baxter
vital_facts: Baptized January, 1968; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Preiesthood as a young adult
BS in Buisness Management, University of Wales, 1976
Married Dianne Lewars February 24, 1979; Sealed in London Temple same day
Senior executive for British Telecom, member of the board of Home Office Agency in British government
Bishop, Stake President, Counselor to England London Mission President, Counselor to Europe West Area President
